ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather ENVIRONMENT.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants ENVIRONMENT.

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

13. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
